phase-summary.outcome: Documented a dedicated future phase for spatial topology, reusable placement primitives, and Unreal map sync so the current schema-alignment work can continue without collapsing region/town/wilderness/floor semantics into one misleading class hierarchy.

file.description: Added phase 58 roadmap entry with four execution slices covering terminology, schema/codegen payloads, editor UX, and Unreal placement workflow.
Registered and closed task 58-01 as the documentation slice for the new spatial topology phase.
Recorded the decision to separate reusable placement primitives from game-specific topology semantics.
Captured the user direction around DungeonBreak regions, Escape the Dungeon floors, room reuse, and Unreal one-click placement intent.

decision.summary: Future spatial authoring must share placement primitives without pretending that DungeonBreak regions and Escape the Dungeon floors are the same gameplay concept.
decision.impact: Later phases can reuse transforms, anchors, room placement, and Unreal sync payloads while keeping game-specific topology semantics explicit.

tests.test: XML parse validation for ROADMAP.xml, TASK-REGISTRY.xml, DECISIONS.xml, and 58-01-PLAN.xml.

next.action: Resume phase 56 execution until shared-schema authoring, overlay warnings, and bundle-backed gameplay paths are stable enough to discuss the dedicated topology phase in detail.
